Libraries bundled in the offline topology viewer (topology.html)
================================================================

The viewer embeds these files unchanged, as published on npm. They are loaded only by the viewer page, never fetched from a network.

  3d-force-graph 1.80.1   vendor/3d-force-graph.min.js   MIT   https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph
  force-graph 1.52.0      vendor/force-graph.min.js      MIT   https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph
  Chart.js 4.4.8          vendor/chart.umd.js            MIT   https://www.chartjs.org

The two graph bundles include, as built by their author: three.js (MIT); d3-force-3d, d3-array, d3-drag, d3-scale,
d3-scale-chromatic, d3-selection and d3-zoom (ISC); @tweenjs/tween.js, bezier-js, canvas-color-tracker, kapsule,
accessor-fn, three-forcegraph and three-render-objects (MIT). Their licence notices are kept in the bundles.
